meta.title: SLATE clothing catalogue research: Toronto, Vancouver (CAD) and Mexico City (MXN)

currency.CA: CAD, shelf price before GST/HST/PST (Ontario HST 13%; BC GST 5% + PST 7%, children’s clothing exempt from BC PST)

meta.priceRule: price = regular listed price; salePrice = markdown shown on 2026-10-01 or null.
meta.confirmedRule: confirmed:true only where the product page itself (or the JSON the page renders from: Uniqlo, Arc’teryx, Gap Inc., Nike, VTEX/Andrea, Shopify) was read on 2026-10-01. confirmed:false means a category feed (Zara) or a search-engine snippet of the product page.
caveats: Zara México: name, price and colours from Zara’s own category feed; product pages sit behind a bot check, so sizes and composition were not read (null).
Sizes on Uniqlo, C&A and some Liverpool items are the sizes the site currently offers online, which may omit sold-out sizes.
Snippet items (confirmed:false) carry sizes/colours/material null unless the snippet stated them.
Canada Goose shopify JSON at the root domain is in USD; CAD prices were read from the /ca/en product pages instead.
Lululemon, H&M, Roots, Aritzia, Joe Fresh, Mark’s, Moores, Coppel, Bershka, Pull&Bear, adidas and Suburbia blocked automated page reads (HTTP 403, bot checks or timeouts).
